text: The legacy API (`/api/v0`) and the redirect of URLs without version prefix are still online at the time of checking, but will be shut down ([#15](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-tech-reports/issues/15)). After that, the API calls in D7.1 and the v0 examples in this section no longer work against dracor.org. Use API v1, see the [current API documentation](https://dracor.org/doc/api).

These additions were released with [API 1.1.0](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-api/releases/tag/v1.1.0) on 13 July 2025; the link to the draft release in footnote 37 no longer works. Later releases: see the [dracor-api releases](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-api/releases) (current version 1.4.1).

The examples in this section were run against the DTS implementation on staging.dracor.org in spring 2025 (DTS draft 1-alpha). Production (dracor.org, API 1.4.1) still implements this draft, but staging now implements DTS 1.0 (API 1.5.0 release candidate): responses there differ from the outputs shown here, and some identifiers of citable units have changed (e.g. `front/div[2]` is now `front/castList[1]`). The notebook mentioned in footnote 129 as it was at the time of the report: [tag 2026-11-15-baseline](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-notebooks/blob/2026-11-15-baseline/dts/dts.ipynb) ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.24237155](https://hdl.handle.net/10.5281/zenodo.24237155)).
The MCP server mentioned here was a prototype at the time of the report. Current version: [dracor-mcp](https://github.com/dracor-org/dracor-mcp) 1.0.0-beta.2 (November 2026).
